blocks.prompt: 2 (i) [printed as a second 1 (i)] Find the total area and the signed area between the graph of \(y = x^{2} - 4\) and the \(x\)-axis over the interval \([-3, -1]\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein do alag cheezein poochi gayi hain, aur farq samajhna hi asal sabaq hai.
Signed area sirf definite integral hai: axis ke neeche wala hissa minus mein ginta hai.
Total area mein har hissa positive ginte hain, is liye jahan curve axis ko cross kare wahan interval ko torna parta hai.
Plan: \(x^{2} - 4 = 0\) se root nikalna, har tukre ka integral, phir signs ke saath jama (signed) aur absolute values ke saath jama (total).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = x^{2} - 4\), interval \([-3, -1]\).
Maloom karna: signed area \(\int_{-3}^{-1} y\,dx\) aur total area \(\int_{-3}^{-1} |y|\,dx\).
Tareeqa: Interval ko us root par torenge jo andar aata hai (3.7.1 ka Note 2). Wajah yeh hai ke total area mein neeche wala hissa bhi positive ginna hai.

Qadam 1: Curve axis ko kahan kaatta hai?
\[x^{2} - 4 = 0 \Rightarrow x = \pm 2\]
Sirf \(x = -2\) interval \([-3, -1]\) ke andar hai. \([-3, -2]\) par \(y \ge 0\) (maslan \(y(-2.5) = 2.25\)); \([-2, -1]\) par \(y \le 0\) (maslan \(y(-1.5) = -1.75\)).
Kyun: Sign sirf root par badalta hai, is liye har tukre mein ek test point kaafi hai.
Dhyan dein: \(x = 2\) bhi root hai lekin woh is interval se bahar hai, us par torna ghalat hoga.

Qadam 2: Antiderivative aur us ki values
\[F(x) = \dfrac{x^{3}}{3} - 4x\]
\[F(-3) = -9 + 12 = 3\]
\[F(-2) = -\dfrac{8}{3} + 8 = \dfrac{16}{3}\]
\[F(-1) = -\dfrac{1}{3} + 4 = \dfrac{11}{3}\]
Kyun: Power rule se \(\int x^{2}dx = \frac{x^{3}}{3}\) aur \(\int 4\,dx = 4x\). Har zaroori point par \(F\) ek hi dafa nikal liya to baar baar hisaab nahi karna parega.
Dhyan dein: \((-3)^{3} = -27\), aur \(-4(-3) = +12\); negative numbers ke cube aur product mein sign ka khayal rakhiye.

Qadam 3: Har tukre ka integral
\[\int_{-3}^{-2} y\,dx = \dfrac{16}{3} - 3 = \dfrac{7}{3}\]
\[\int_{-2}^{-1} y\,dx = \dfrac{11}{3} - \dfrac{16}{3} = -\dfrac{5}{3}\]
Kyun: Doosra tukra negative aaya kyunke wahan curve axis ke neeche hai; yeh bilkul expected tha, Qadam 1 ne yehi bataya tha.

Qadam 4: Signed aur total area
\[\text{Signed} = \dfrac{7}{3} - \dfrac{5}{3} = \dfrac{2}{3}\]
\[\text{Total} = \dfrac{7}{3} + \dfrac{5}{3} = 4\]
Kyun: Signed area mein minus sign qaim rehta hai, is liye upar aur neeche ke hisse ek doosre ko kuch cancel karte hain. Total area mein dono hisson ka size (absolute value) jama karte hain, jaise zameen ke do tukron ka rakba jama karte hain.

Tasdeeq:
Signed area ko baghair tore bhi nikal sakte hain: \(F(-1) - F(-3) = \frac{11}{3} - 3 = \frac{2}{3}\). Wohi jawab aaya, is liye hisaab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: Signed area \(= \frac{2}{3}\); total area \(= 4\) square units.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) [printed as a second 1 (ii)] Find the total area and the signed area between the graph of \(y = x^{2} - 4\) and the \(x\)-axis over the interval \([-3, 3]\).
blocks.explanation:
Function wohi hai, sirf interval bara ho gaya hai.
Ab dono roots \(x = -2\) aur \(x = 2\) interval \([-3, 3]\) ke andar hain, is liye total area ke liye teen tukre banenge.
Signed area phir bhi seedha ek integral hai.
Plan: wohi antiderivative, har tukre ka integral, phir jama.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = x^{2} - 4\), interval \([-3, 3]\).
Maloom karna: signed area aur total area.
Tareeqa: \(x = -2\) aur \(x = 2\) par torenge. Saath hi symmetry use karenge: \(y = x^{2} - 4\) even function hai, yani \(y\)-axis ke dono taraf graph aaina (mirror) jaisa hai.

Qadam 1: Signed area
\[\int_{-3}^{3}(x^{2} - 4)\,dx = \left[\dfrac{x^{3}}{3} - 4x\right]_{-3}^{3}\]
\[= (9 - 12) - (-9 + 12) = -6\]
Kyun: Signed area sirf seedha definite integral hai, torne ki zaroorat nahi. Negative jawab ka matlab hai ke axis ke neeche wala hissa upar wale hisson se bara hai.

Qadam 2: Teen tukre
\[\int_{-3}^{-2} y\,dx = \dfrac{7}{3},\quad \int_{2}^{3} y\,dx = \dfrac{7}{3}\]
\[\int_{-2}^{2} y\,dx = \left(\dfrac{8}{3} - 8\right) - \left(-\dfrac{8}{3} + 8\right)\]
\[= -\dfrac{32}{3}\]
Kyun: Pehla tukra part (i) mein nikal chuke hain; symmetry ki wajah se aakhri tukra bhi utna hi hai. Darmiyan wala tukra axis ke neeche hai, is liye negative aaya.

Qadam 3: Total area
\[\dfrac{7}{3} + \dfrac{32}{3} + \dfrac{7}{3} = \dfrac{46}{3}\]
Kyun: Total area mein har tukre ka size positive lete hain.
Dhyan dein: Agar aap \(-6\) ko hi area likh dein ya \(|-6| = 6\) likh dein to ghalat hoga; total area ke liye torna lazmi hai.

Tasdeeq:
Tukron ko signs ke saath jama karein: \(\frac{7}{3} - \frac{32}{3} + \frac{7}{3} = -\frac{18}{3} = -6\). Yeh Qadam 1 ke signed area se mil gaya, is liye dono jawab sahi hain.
blocks.final_answer: Signed area \(= -6\); total area \(= \frac{46}{3}\) square units.
